Indian AI Startup Sarvam Offers Early Access to New Models for Creators

Indian AI startup Sarvam announced a new initiative to provide creators with early access to its upcoming AI models. The company stated this plan aims to boost engagement with its technology. This move is intended to allow creators to experiment with and utilize new AI capabilities ahead of wider public release.
